segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: The Alder desktop pilot has 24 seats. We are not expanding it to 40 seats this month.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: The import test passed 87 checks. The export test still has 3 failures.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: Leo, can you send the export report by Tuesday?

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: Yes. I'll send the export report by Tuesday, after I rerun the 3 failing checks.

segments.speaker: Nina
segments.text: I'll review the export report by Wednesday. I am not the shipping owner.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: I will ship version 2.8 on Friday only if Nina approves the export report.

segments.speaker: Nina
segments.text: Could we also add offline search? That is a suggestion, not a task for this release.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: The support guide is already finished. Do not list it as pending.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: I'll notify support on Thursday if the release is still planned for Friday.

segments.speaker: Asha
segments.text: For Birch Studio the current plan is 60 seats at $32 per seat per month.

segments.speaker: Ben
segments.text: We might grow to 80 seats, but procurement has not approved the increase.

segments.speaker: Asha
segments.text: The proposed 80-seat price is $29 per seat per month only with an annual contract. Monthly billing stays at $32.

segments.speaker: Dev
segments.text: I'll send the 80-seat quote to Ben by March 6. It must show both billing options.

segments.speaker: Ben
segments.text: I'll review the quote by March 8 if procurement confirms the seat count.

segments.speaker: Asha
segments.text: Dev will update the residency appendix by March 7. The data must stay in Canada, not the US.

segments.speaker: Dev
segments.text: I won't migrate any data until Ben approves the residency appendix.

segments.speaker: Ben
segments.text: We have not agreed to renew. The current contract ends March 31.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: The Cedar workshop has 18 attendees and 2 rooms. The budget is $900, not $1,900.

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.text: I'll send the room plan by Monday. Correction: I'll send the room plan by Wednesday, not Monday.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: Sam will review the room plan by Thursday.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Yes, I'll review the room plan by Thursday if Noah sends the final version.

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.text: I can explain the projector setup, but I am not committing to bring equipment.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: I'll book the 2 rooms by Friday if Sam approves the room plan.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: The catering order was sent yesterday. There is nothing left to send.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: Do not increase the budget. We have not approved any extra equipment.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: The Dune museum trial has 12 guides and 4 tablets. The audio captions are already finished.

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.text: The west entrance stays closed. Visitors must use the east entrance, not the loading dock.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: I'll send the access map by Thursday only if Omar approves the east entrance route.

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.text: I'll review the access map by Wednesday. We have not approved evening tours.

segments.speaker: Tessa
segments.text: The Elm garden has 16 sensors. The north bed has 5 dry sensors; the south bed has 2.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: The battery replacement was completed yesterday. It is not pending.

segments.speaker: Tessa
segments.text: I'll send the sensor report by June 12 if the north bed readings are confirmed.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: I'll review the sensor report by June 13. Irrigation must stay off until the leak test passes.
